# V4.2024.0 Environmental Indicator Source Data

The tables below identify the source data used in our updated environmental
indicator calculations. "Data period" identifies the year or years
that data was collected for each indicator or shared dataset.

## Environmental indicator sources

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
sample_fips <- "56"
sample_state_name <- "Wyoming"

document_path <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
if (is.null(document_path) || !nzchar(document_path)) {
  stop("Could not determine the location of this R Markdown document.")
}
# current_input(dir = TRUE) returns the full file path, not its directory
document_dir <- dirname(document_path)

external_sources_path <- params$external_sources_path
if (is.null(external_sources_path) || !length(external_sources_path) ||
    is.na(external_sources_path) || !nzchar(external_sources_path)) {
  external_sources_path <- "external_sources.json"
}
if (length(external_sources_path) != 1L) {
  stop("`external_sources_path` must be a single file path.")
}
if (!fs::is_absolute_path(external_sources_path)) {
  external_sources_path <- file.path(document_dir, external_sources_path)
}
external_sources_path <- normalizePath(
  external_sources_path,
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

source_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  external_sources_path,
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)

source_text <- function(value, default = "Not documented") {
  if (is.null(value) || !length(value)) {
    return(default)
  }
  value <- as.character(value[[1L]])
  if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(value)) {
    return(default)
  }
  value
}

escape_text <- function(value) {
  as.character(htmltools::htmlEscape(value))
}

escape_attribute <- function(value) {
  as.character(htmltools::htmlEscape(value, attribute = TRUE))
}

source_groups <- function(section) {
  lapply(names(section), function(key) {
    entry <- section[[key]]
    label <- source_text(entry$display_name_long, default = "")
    if (!nzchar(label)) {
      label <- source_text(entry$display_name_short, default = "")
    }
    if (!nzchar(label)) {
      label <- key
    }

    sources <- entry$external_sources
    if (is.null(sources) || !length(sources)) {
      sources <- list(NULL)
    }

    list(
      label = label,
      provider = source_text(entry$provider),
      data_period = source_text(entry$data_period),
      sources = sources
    )
  })
}

resolved_source_url <- function(value) {
  url <- source_text(value, default = "")
  if (!nzchar(url)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  has_fips <- grepl("{fips}", url, fixed = TRUE)
  if (has_fips) {
    url <- gsub("{fips}", sample_fips, url, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  if (!grepl("^https?://[^[:space:]]+$", url, ignore.case = TRUE) ||
      grepl("\\{[^}]+\\}", url)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  host <- tolower(sub("^https?://([^/?#:]+).*$", "\\1", url, ignore.case = TRUE))
  api_host <- if (startsWith(host, "api.")) host else NULL
  list(url = url, has_fips = has_fips, api_host = api_host)
}

format_source_table <- function(groups, table_type) {
  if (identical(table_type, "indicator")) {
    columns <- c("Indicator", "Provider", "Data period", "Source file")
    column_ids <- c("indicator", "provider", "period", "file")
    caption <- "Environmental indicator source files"
  } else {
    columns <- c(
      "Dataset", "Provider", "Data period",
      "Source file or filename pattern", "Download link"
    )
    column_ids <- c("dataset", "provider", "period", "file", "example")
    caption <- "Shared data source files"
  }

  column_headers <- paste0(
    '<th scope="col" id="', column_ids, '-column">',
    vapply(columns, escape_text, character(1)),
    "</th>",
    collapse = ""
  )

  body_rows <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(groups), function(group_index) {
    group <- groups[[group_index]]
    source_count <- length(group$sources)
    group_id <- paste0(table_type, "-group-", group_index)
    row_headers <- paste0(group_id, "-", c("label", "provider", "period"))
    parent_values <- c(group$label, group$provider, group$data_period)
    parent_cells <- paste0(
      '<th scope="rowgroup" rowspan="', source_count,
      '" id="', row_headers, '" headers="',
      column_ids[seq_len(3L)], '-column">',
      vapply(parent_values, escape_text, character(1)),
      "</th>",
      collapse = ""
    )

    group_rows <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(group$sources), function(source_index) {
      source <- group$sources[[source_index]]
      no_sources <- is.null(source)
      filename <- if (no_sources) {
        "Source files not yet documented"
      } else {
        source_text(source$file_name)
      }
      link <- if (no_sources) NULL else resolved_source_url(source$source_url)

      if (identical(table_type, "indicator")) {
        source_cell <- if (is.null(link)) {
          "Link not available"
        } else if (!is.null(link$api_host)) {
          paste0(
            escape_text(filename), "<br>",
            escape_text(paste("Download via appropriate api call to", link$api_host))
          )
        } else {
          paste0(
            '<a href="', escape_attribute(link$url), '">',
            escape_text(filename), "</a>"
          )
        }
        source_cell <- paste0(
          '<td headers="file-column ', paste(row_headers, collapse = " "),
          '">', source_cell, "</td>"
        )
      } else {
        source_cell <- paste0(
          '<td headers="file-column ', paste(row_headers, collapse = " "),
          '"><code>', escape_text(filename), "</code></td>"
        )
        link_text <- if (is.null(link)) {
          "Link not available"
        } else if (!is.null(link$api_host)) {
          paste("Download via a call to", link$api_host)
        } else if (link$has_fips) {
          paste("Sample state download")
        } else {
          "Download"
        }
        example_cell <- if (is.null(link) || !is.null(link$api_host)) {
          paste0(
            '<td headers="example-column ',
            paste(row_headers, collapse = " "),
            '">', escape_text(link_text), "</td>"
          )
        } else {
          paste0(
            '<td headers="example-column ',
            paste(row_headers, collapse = " "),
            '"><a href="', escape_attribute(link$url), '">',
            escape_text(link_text), "</a></td>"
          )
        }
        source_cell <- paste0(source_cell, example_cell)
      }

      group_cells <- if (source_index == 1L) parent_cells else ""
      paste0(
        "<tr>", group_cells, source_cell, "</tr>"
      )
    }), use.names = FALSE)
    paste0("<tbody>", paste0(group_rows, collapse = ""), "</tbody>")
  }), use.names = FALSE)

  style <- paste0(
    "<style>",
    ".source-data-table-wrapper{max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;}",
    ".source-data-table{width:100%;min-width:38rem;border-collapse:collapse;}",
    ".source-data-table th,.source-data-table td{border:1px solid #b8b8b8;",
    "padding:.45rem .6rem;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;",
    "overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word;}",
    ".source-data-table th{background:#f2f2f2;}",
    ".source-data-table code{white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}",
    "</style>"
  )

  paste0(
    style,
    '<div class="source-data-table-wrapper"><table class="source-data-table">',
    "<caption>", escape_text(caption), "</caption>",
    "<thead><tr>", column_headers, "</tr></thead>",
    paste0(body_rows, collapse = ""),
    "</table></div>"
  )
}
```

```{r indicator-sources, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
knitr::asis_output(
  format_source_table(source_groups(source_data$indicators), "indicator")
)
```

## Shared data sources

These datasets support processing across the project. Provider and data
period describe each shared dataset as a whole; individual source files
may represent different years or come from different providers.

State-specific filenames contain `{fips}`, a placeholder for the
two-digit state FIPS code. Example links currently use **56 (Wyoming)**.
The population-data example returns a Census API response.

Links point to external providers and may change or become unavailable.

```{r shared-sources, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
knitr::asis_output(
  format_source_table(source_groups(source_data$shared), "shared")
)
```
